how: kubectl -n signoz exec chi-signoz-clickhouse-cluster-0-0-0 -c clickhouse -- clickhouse-client --query "..."

queries.title: Every span of one trace, with parent links
queries.why: The timeout run. Shows the frontend stopping near 1 s while the backend carries on to 3 s.
queries.sql: SELECT toString(timestamp) AS ts, resource_string_service$$name AS service, name, kind_string AS kind, status_code_string AS status, response_status_code AS http, round(duration_nano/1e6,1) AS ms, span_id, parent_span_id FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE trace_id='ab23d22ff92a4c83b20b29657447a38b' ORDER BY timestamp

queries.title: Slowest SQL statements
queries.sql: SELECT attributes_string['db.statement'] AS statement, count() AS calls, round(avg(duration_nano)/1e6,1) AS avg_ms, round(max(duration_nano)/1e6,1) AS max_ms FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE attributes_string['db.system']='postgresql' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-11-04 23:08:00' AND '2026-11-04 23:59:00' GROUP BY statement ORDER BY max_ms DESC LIMIT 6

rows: INSERT INTO orders (item, qty, total) VALUES (%s, %s, %s) RETURNING id
SELECT id, item, qty, total, created_at FROM orders ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20

queries.title: Exception types recorded on spans
queries.why: Reads the events array. The same types appear on the Exceptions page.
queries.sql: SELECT resource_string_service$$name AS service, JSONExtractString(e,'attributeMap','exception.type') AS exception_type, count() AS n FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 ARRAY JOIN events AS e WHERE JSONExtractString(e,'name')='exception' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-11-04 23:08:00' AND '2026-11-04 23:59:00' GROUP BY service, exception_type ORDER BY n DESC

queries.title: Logs for one trace
queries.why: The db_error run. Three logs from two services under one trace ID.
queries.sql: SELECT toString(fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)) AS ts, resources_string['service.name'] AS service, severity_text AS severity, substring(body,1,90) AS body FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE trace_id='8b890cacc615088c5d6508a6e8b7cfcc' ORDER BY timestamp

rows: query failed: relation "table_that_does_not_exist" does not exist
HTTP Request: GET http://backend:8000/work/db-error "HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error"

queries.title: OTLP copies versus stdout copies
queries.why: Gap 4 in numbers, over the 51-minute load run.
queries.sql: SELECT if(resources_string['service.name']='', 'stdout copy (k8s-infra)', 'OTLP copy') AS copy, count() AS n, countIf(trace_id!='') AS with_trace_id, countIf(severity_text!='') AS with_severity FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN toUnixTimestamp64Nano(toDateTime64('2026-11-04 23:08:00',9)) AND toUnixTimestamp64Nano(toDateTime64('2026-11-04 23:59:00',9)) AND (resources_string['service.name'] IN ('frontend','backend') OR resources_string['k8s.namespace.name']='lab2') GROUP BY copy ORDER BY copy

queries.title: What the stdout log lines actually are
queries.why: Sorts the stdout copies from the load run by what each line is. The twins match the OTLP count exactly.
queries.sql: SELECT multiIf(resources_string['k8s.container.name']='postgres','Postgres', body LIKE '%trace_id=%','Twin of an OTLP log (trace_id only as text)', body LIKE 'INFO:%/healthz%','Health probe access line', body LIKE 'INFO:%','uvicorn access line', body LIKE '%File "%' OR body LIKE ' %' OR body LIKE '%Traceback (most recent%','Stack trace line, one record per line','Other') AS kind, count() AS n FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN toUnixTimestamp64Nano(toDateTime64('2026-11-04 23:08:00',9)) AND toUnixTimestamp64Nano(toDateTime64('2026-11-04 23:59:00',9)) AND resources_string['service.name']='' AND resources_string['k8s.namespace.name']='lab2' GROUP BY kind ORDER BY n DESC

Twin of an OTLP log (trace_id only as text)

queries.title: Spans with Kubernetes context
queries.sql: SELECT count() AS spans, countIf(resources_string['k8s.pod.name']!='') AS with_pod_name FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '2026-11-04 23:08:00' AND '2026-11-04 23:59:00'

queries.title: Share of ASGI send and receive spans
queries.sql: SELECT count() AS spans, countIf(name LIKE '% http send' OR name LIKE '% http receive') AS asgi_noise, round(100*asgi_noise/spans,1) AS pct FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE timestamp BETWEEN '2026-11-04 23:08:00' AND '2026-11-04 23:59:00'

queries.title: The rows that decide who appears on Services
queries.why: `time` here is when the row was written. `backend` only has rows from about 45 seconds.
queries.sql: SELECT serviceName, count() AS ops, toString(min(time)) AS first_row, toString(max(time)) AS last_row FROM signoz_traces.distributed_top_level_operations GROUP BY serviceName ORDER BY serviceName

queries.title: The rows behind the Service Map
queries.sql: SELECT src, dest, count() AS rows_, toString(min(timestamp)) AS first_row, toString(max(timestamp)) AS last_row, sum(total_count) AS calls FROM signoz_traces.distributed_dependency_graph_minutes_v2 GROUP BY src, dest

queries.title: How often the two views wrote anything
queries.why: `system.query_views_log` records each view run. Rows in it age out, so counts depend on when you run this.
queries.sql: SELECT view_name, count() AS runs, countIf(written_rows>0) AS runs_with_rows, sum(written_rows) AS rows_written FROM system.query_views_log WHERE view_name LIKE '%sub_root_operations%' OR view_name LIKE '%dependency_graph_minutes_service_calls_mv_v2%' GROUP BY view_name

queries.title: Backend latency during the CPU burn
queries.why: p50 of unrelated routes in the 90 seconds of the burn. Run once per window: 23:13:00-23:15:40, 23:15:46-23:17:12, 23:17:20-23:19:00. Saved output is the "during" window.
queries.sql: SELECT name, count() AS n, round(quantile(0.5)(duration_nano)/1e6,1) AS p50_ms, round(quantile(0.95)(duration_nano)/1e6,1) AS p95_ms FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE resource_string_service$$name='backend' AND kind_string='Server' AND name IN ('GET /orders','POST /orders') AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-11-04 23:15:46' AND '2026-11-04 23:17:12' GROUP BY name ORDER BY name

queries.title: Raw CPU samples for the backend pod
queries.why: One sample every 30 seconds. `sample` is a reserved word in ClickHouse SQL, so the alias is `s`.
queries.sql: SELECT toString(toDateTime(intDiv(s.unix_milli,1000))) AS t, round(s.value,3) AS cores FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_samples_v4 AS s WHERE s.metric_name='k8s.pod.cpu.usage' AND s.fingerprint IN (SELECT fingerprint FROM signoz_metrics.distributed_time_series_v4 WHERE metric_name='k8s.pod.cpu.usage' AND JSONExtractString(labels,'k8s.pod.name') LIKE 'backend-%') AND s.unix_milli BETWEEN 1793833800000 AND 1793834400000 ORDER BY s.unix_milli
